description.en: Slender axes bear spirally arranged leaves split into a long middle segment and paired side divisions.
description.zh: 细轴螺旋着生裂叶，叶具细长中央裂片及成对侧裂片。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Leclercqia complexa; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Leclercqia complexa 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Five-part leaf silhouette is absent from both the existing lycopsid tree and simple bottlebrush Baragwanathia.
distinctness.zh: 五裂叶轮廓不同于现有石松类树木及简单瓶刷状Baragwanathia。

modeling_brief.en: Model the repeated leaf as one angular forked unit; make its central recurved tip legible at thumbnail scale.
modeling_brief.zh: 把重复叶片做成单一角状分叉单元，让中央回曲尖端在缩略图上可辨。

uncertainty: The ligule is not modeled; whole-plant spread remains incompletely known.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Leclercqia complexa gen. et sp. nov., a new lycopod from the late Middle Devonian
sources.supports: Diagnostic divided leaves with elongate central segment.

sources.title: Early Land Plants laboratory
sources.supports: Named fossil specimens including Sawdonia, Psilophyton, Baragwanathia and Leclercqia.
